access_note: Public source is on GitHub. Running the MyGeoHub hosted tool requires login, according to the own README. Live portal access was not tested.
description: The Climate Scenario Aggregator prepares projected temperature and precipitation for climate-impact analysis. Its contributors publish source for a web tool that selects and aggregates monthly, bias-corrected global grids from five ISI-MIP general circulation models. The own README states a half-degree source grid and historical and future scenarios. Users choose a region, period and aggregation settings, producing climate summaries for a crop or water-demand simulation. Coverage depends on the available ISI-MIP model years and chosen region; no individual asset is represented. The public source is free under GPL-3.0-or-later. The hosted MyGeoHub interface requires login, and its live status was not verified. Running a separate installation requires older software dependencies and a Globus endpoint. A limitation is that averaging a coarse grid may hide local heat or rainfall extremes and does not settle projection uncertainty. No related catalogue record was identified. No climate grids or source archive were downloaded.
